name: @alepek/gmail-mcp-local
description: Local-first Gmail MCP server for Claude & Cursor — Gmail tools with OAuth tokens that never leave your machine (stored in the OS keychain).
comment_optionalDependencies: These native keychain modules are needed ONLY for real on-device custody (OsKeychainBackend). The seam and its tests use MemoryKeychainBackend and require neither. Install one for real use: npm i @napi-rs/keyring
